notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-receive-retrieve-set (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): RECEIVE SET and RETRIEVE SET. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: short-input
scenarios.why: RECEIVE SET the 6 typed bytes into a pointer

scenarios.name: retrieve-equal

scenarios.name: enddata
scenarios.why: START INTERVAL(0) with no FROM: the first RETRIEVE SET is ENDDATA
